expected_path_summary: Initial downside pressure on USDJPY is expected as markets digest inflation data and anticipate Fed policy. A reversal is possible as the market focuses on the Fed's likely hawkish stance.
information_used: The forecast is driven by the primary importance of Core Inflation Rate YoY (May) and Core Inflation Rate MoM (May) indicators, which are key drivers for Fed policy expectations. Headline Inflation Rate YoY (May) and Headline Inflation Rate MoM (May) also play significant roles. The USDJPY spot level and recent trend data are used as context. Treasury yield data (2-year and 10-year) provides insight into market expectations. The release of CPI data is the primary catalyst.
invalidation_condition: A significant deviation in the actual CPI (YoY/MoM and Core) from consensus, especially a hotter-than-expected reading, could invalidate the initial downside expectation and lead to a stronger upward move. Unexpected dovish signals from the Fed during the press conference or rate decision would also invalidate this forecast.
missing_information: Detailed FOMC projections and market-implied rate cut probabilities were not available, which would have provided more granular insight into the Fed's forward guidance. Real-time market positioning data and comprehensive risk sentiment indicators were also unavailable. Specific historical sensitivity of USDJPY to CPI data surprises was not directly incorporated.
